summary: Agent skill that turns a one-line request into finished designs: clickable app prototypes, slide decks, motion videos and infographics.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Huashu Design is a skill for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw and Hermes. You describe what you want and it produces design deliverables: single-file HTML app prototypes, HTML slide decks with editable PPTX, MP4 and GIF motion design, infographics, social carousels and App Store screenshots.
sixtySeconds.problem: Making a launch video, deck or prototype normally needs design tools and skills. This skill gets an agent to produce them from a prompt, and can read your brand assets to match your style.
whoFor: Founders and marketers who need launch assets
Agent users who don't use design tools
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for many deliverable types from one skill, with the core pipeline running locally with no API keys.
requirements: An agent that supports skills (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others)

overview: Install it with npx skills add. The skill includes 430+ referenced files in references, assets, scripts and demos folders, so check they all installed; if not, update the skills tool or git clone the repo into your skills folder.
Give it your logo, colors or screenshots and it follows your brand. With nothing, it proposes design directions to choose from. Typical jobs take about 3 to 30 minutes.
The design, render and export pipeline runs locally. Optional cloud features (narration, AI video review) use your own keys. It is MIT licensed, except demo stickers under a separate license.
